questions.question: Who was the Aramean commander healed of leprosy?
What did Elisha tell Naaman to do to be healed?
options: Offer a lamb on the altar
Bathe in the river of Damascus
Wash seven times in the Jordan
questions.answer: Wash seven times in the Jordan

questions.question: Naaman was angry at first but then obeyed and was healed.
_____, commander of the army of Aram, was healed of his leprosy.
Naaman dipped _____ times in the Jordan and his skin was restored.
